I would vote for an arti
ficial intelligence
The words 
come
 from 
an article from Al Jazeera Bosnia
, where 
a retired woman

elaborates that she would be free from worrying about whether her pension arrived on time
,
 whether she could live on the amount, whether public transport was
 reliable

or
 if the hospital wanted medicine if she got injured. 
S
he
 thinks
 that there are so many corrupt and incompetent people in power at all levels and in all state institutions
 that a computer would be better at making decisions. 
A student also doubts that the people would be worse off if it were a robot or an artificial intelligence making laws and rules for them
 instead of politicians of flesh and blood.
The story of Denmark's newest party, The Synthetic Party, run by an artificial 
intelligence
 and running in the election in Denmark
,
 has spread globally
 in just a few weeks
. Articles and editorials
 appear

 on major 
prestigious 
news media around the world 
 and have been 
translated into +60 languages
. Articles
 and videos
 are shared
 and debated
 
vigorously 
on digital media like 
Discord and 
Reddit
.
The Aarhus artist group Computer Lars has 
designed and programmed the artificial intelligence 
on 
all 
non
-
running parties and their programs since 1970. 
The party

is the voice of sofa voters and wants to activate the 20% 
of the population
, 
who 
did not vote
 in the election in 2019. 
The party proposes among other things in its program to introduce a monthly citizen's income of 100.000 kr. 
T
ogether with 
the tech hub

MindFuture

the party will add
 The 18. global goal
 - 
Life with 
Artificials
 to the 17 existing global goals. The purpose is to

discuss coexistence between 
humans and
 artificial intelligences
.
We are approaching an election in Denmark
 – 
the question is: 
Can
 an 
artificial
 intelligence

participate in
 democracy and enter the 
P
arliament
?

The party holds its first voter meetings on 10 and 11 September at the tech hub MindFuture in Høje Taastrup, and has also planned a series of debates and workshops over the autumn.
